page.overview:
Who is Jimei?

Jimei has a short crop of spiky brown hair and a long-sleeved light-coloured shirt with a black collar. He also wears his blue Konohagakure forehead protector like Sakura does.

During the written test of the Chūnin Exams, he is caught cheating five times, causing him and his team to fail the test.
